items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names reveal intent (flushChunk, writeHeader, decodeKey, getEncryptor). The package doc describes the stream format, the pipeline closer ordering is commented, and short receiver names (ew, dr) are normal Go style. Formatting is gofmt-clean.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Structure is good: config.go and encryption.go are split and Validate is table-driven. But it imports stdlib "crypto/pbkdf2" instead of the vendored x/crypto/pbkdf2 the conventions require, and storage.PathGenerator hardcodes `EnsureFileName(filename, gzip, false, unique)` instead of updating callers.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Checks key length with ErrInvalidKey wrapped via %w and clones the key. Has a maxFrameLen bound, ErrClosed, idempotent Close that keeps its error state, and truncation mapped to ErrUnexpectedEOF. The key is loaded before storages are created. Only nit: a few errors are wrapped with %v.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: The required signature changes are done and unencrypted gzip output is unchanged. However, storage.PathGenerator keeps its old signature and passes a hardcoded `false`, so backend callers were wrapped rather than updated. Also, a filename already ending in .enc keeps that suffix when encryption is off.
